trial.title: How the trial works
trial.body: The trial starts after you finish setting up your first business and is available once to the person paying for the subscription. You get STUDIO access for 21 days. Adding a workspace does not start another 21 days.

capabilities.title: Included in both plans
capabilities.inbox: Requests and orders that need your attention
capabilities.booking: Public booking link — your clients choose a service and time directly on your page
capabilities.clients: Client profiles with visit history, notes and payment records
capabilities.payments: Payment records for appointments and orders
capabilities.finance: Revenue, costs and outstanding balances without a spreadsheet
capabilities.orders: Orders with payment schedules and due dates
capabilities.packages: Packages of prepaid credits that draw down as you use them
capabilities.onboarding: Niche-aware onboarding with 32 selectable business types and editable service lists
capabilities.contactImport: Contact import from your phone via vCard

billing.title: After the trial
billing.body: Each workspace needs its own monthly subscription. After the trial, choose SOLO or STUDIO if you want to keep using it.
billing.renewal: Once purchased, a subscription renews monthly under the subscription terms.

faq.title: Questions about pricing and billing
faq.q1: When does the trial start, and can I get another?
faq.a1: After you finish setting up your first business. The trial is available once to the person paying for the subscription. Adding a workspace does not start another 21 days.
faq.q2: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a2: After the trial, choose SOLO or STUDIO for each workspace you want to keep using. The trial does not turn into a paid subscription automatically. Without a subscription or another valid source of access, work is restricted; trial expiry itself does not delete your data.
faq.q3: Who counts toward the service-professional limit?
faq.a3: Anyone who provides services, including a working owner and a professional without their own app login. An administrator who does not provide services does not count toward this limit.
faq.q4: Can I choose SOLO after the trial?
faq.a4: Yes. Before switching, keep one active service professional, remove access for other team members and cancel pending invitations. Staff records are not deleted automatically.
faq.a5: Once purchased, your subscription renews monthly. Final currency, applicable taxes and terms are shown before payment.
faq.q6: I work on my own but have an administrator helping me. Which plan should I choose?
faq.a6: Choose STUDIO if your administrator needs their own access to Perelai. They do not use a professional place unless they provide services. SOLO fits if you manage the workspace yourself and one professional provides services without their own login.
